title: Symlink-safe scanning, shared agent skills, and a rules-and-checks map
summary: This change does three things at once. It hardens `osf scan` so a symlink is never walked or read: `collect_files` now uses `symlink_metadata` and counts links as skipped, and `scan_paths` re-checks each target, so a scan of nothing but links reports `excluded` rather than clean. It consolidates agent instructions into one shared home, `.agents/skills/`, with `.claude/skills` kept as a git symlink to it, and adds folder-scoped `AGENTS.md` files plus a maintainer page mapping each rule to what enforces it. Finally, CI gains two steps in the `rust` job: lint every skill folder, and fail if `.claude/skills` is not a symlink to `../.agents/skills`.

nodes.label: osf CLI
nodes.subtitle: osf scan / osf lint skill
nodes.summary: Parses the command line and dispatches to the scan and lint libraries. Unchanged here, but it is the entry point every new scan behaviour is observed through.

nodes.label: scan_paths
nodes.subtitle: pub fn scan_paths(dir, paths, rules, excluder)
nodes.summary: Now seeds its dropped counter with the number of symlinks the resolver skipped, and re-checks each resolved target with `symlink_metadata` before reading it, so a link that slipped through is counted as excluded instead of read.

nodes.label: resolve_scan_targets
nodes.subtitle: returns (targets, skipped)
nodes.summary: Returns the skipped-symlink count alongside the target list. With no paths it still asks git for tracked files and reports zero skipped; with explicit paths it threads a counter through the walk.

nodes.label: collect_files
nodes.subtitle: recursive walk, symlink-aware
nodes.summary: Switched from `metadata` to `symlink_metadata` and returns early on a symlink, incrementing `skipped`. This is what stops a link to a directory, or a link that cycles back on an ancestor, from being walked.

nodes.label: git tracked files
nodes.subtitle: crate::git::tracked_files
nodes.summary: Supplies the default target list when no paths are given. Unchanged, and the reason a repo whose only tracked entry is a symlink still reaches the resolver.

nodes.label: ScanOutcome
nodes.subtitle: files, excluded
nodes.summary: The result a caller reads. Its `excluded` count now includes skipped symlinks, which is what makes a scan of only links report `1 excluded` rather than a clean zero.

nodes.label: Working tree
nodes.subtitle: files and symlinks on disk
nodes.summary: The real files and the symlinks pointing at them. The change is about never following the links here.

nodes.label: Git index
nodes.subtitle: tracked paths, symlink mode 120000
nodes.summary: Names the tracked files a default scan reads, and records `.claude/skills` with mode 120000 when it is a real symlink.

nodes.label: rust job
nodes.subtitle: .github/workflows/ci.yml
nodes.summary: Gains two steps: lint every skill folder under `skills/` and `.agents/skills/`, and verify `.claude/skills` is a symlink to `../.agents/skills`.

nodes.label: Check the skills
nodes.subtitle: osf lint skill --format human
nodes.summary: Collects every `SKILL.md` folder from git and lints them all in one run, with a notice when there are none.

nodes.label: Check the Claude Code skills link
nodes.subtitle: git ls-files -s .claude/skills
nodes.summary: Fails the job unless git records `.claude/skills` with mode 120000 and `readlink` resolves it to `../.agents/skills`, with a Windows fix hint in the error.

nodes.label: .agents/skills
nodes.subtitle: shared skill home
nodes.summary: The one home for skills every coding agent shares, holding seven new SKILL.md files covering commands, issues, pull requests, reviews, sub-agents, and workflows.

nodes.label: .claude/skills
nodes.subtitle: symlink to ../.agents/skills
nodes.summary: A git symlink, not a copy, so Claude Code reads the same skills as every other agent. The CI step exists to keep it from drifting into a duplicate folder.

nodes.label: Folder AGENTS.md files
nodes.subtitle: crates/, .github/workflows/
nodes.summary: Folder-scoped rules moved out of the root AGENTS.md: crate layout and language rules under `crates/`, and workflow secret and pinning rules under `.github/workflows/`.

nodes.label: rules-and-checks.md
nodes.subtitle: rule to enforcement map
nodes.summary: A maintainer page listing each agent-facing rule, where it is stated, and what enforces it, with 'not enforced' where nothing does.

nodes.label: scan.rs tests
nodes.subtitle: five new symlink cases
nodes.summary: Adds cases for a tracked symlink to a directory, a repo of only a symlink, an explicit symlinked path, a nested symlinked directory, and a symlink cycle, each asserting the link is counted excluded and never read.

nodes.label: TempRepo::symlink
nodes.subtitle: test helper
nodes.summary: Creates a symlink in a temp repo, choosing file or directory links on Windows and creating parent directories, so the dangling-link and cycle cases can be built.
